title: Boy Meets Maria
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On his first day of high school, impulsive Taiga Hirosawa falls for 'Maria', then learns that Maria is Arima, a classmate who performs female roles in the drama club. As they rehearse a school play, Arima keeps Taiga at a distance, and both slowly reveal trauma and the roles they use to protect themselves. A single-volume story about gender, performance and healing.
life_message: It holds up seeing past the roles people perform and accepting someone, and yourself, as they are.

content.note: A burst of violence and domestic abuse in the background (SOLRAD review).
Flashbacks, panic attacks and an onstage breakdown (SOLRAD; AniList Tragedy, Psychological).
Past sexual assault is part of the trauma (SOLRAD; MangaUpdates Rape); BL romance is tentative (AniList Boys' Love 78%); explicitness to verify.
Homophobic and transphobic slurs from classmates (SOLRAD).
Trauma, panic attacks and bullying with support from friends and adults (SOLRAD; AniList Psychological genre).
Characters learn when their behavior harms others.

dominant: Gender as performance (postmodernism); progressive affirmation of identity; healing from trauma
